title: saxifraga lyallii subsp. hultenii
intro: Saxifraga lyallii subsp. hultenii, commonly known as Lyall's saxifrage, is a plant species that belongs to the Saxifragaceae family. It is a flowering plant that grows in the mountainous regions of New Zealand and is often used for its medicinal properties. Lyall's saxifrage has been traditionally used to treat a variety of health issues, including digestive problems, and is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular choice for herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
